figurative_meaning_en: Naturally inclined to provide benefit or help spontaneously
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার উপযাচক মনোভাব সবাইকে সাহায্য করে।
এই গাছটি উপযাচক, ছায়া দেয় ছাড়াই চাওয়া।
example_sentences_in_english: His benevolent nature helps everyone spontaneously.
This tree is naturally helpful, providing shade without being asked.
note: Refers to inherent helpfulness without solicitation, rooted in Bengali linguistic nuance.
